correctness.rationale: An integer polynomial identity and resultant prove precise period-three roots and period-six graph cycles. Exact degree-six irreducibility modulo 5 and a 1+1+1+3 factorization modulo 11 prove that the Galois group is C3 wreath C2 of order 18; discriminant -41472 gives the unique quadratic field Q(sqrt(-2)). The compositum with Q(zeta_24) has degree 72. Its nine congruence-compatible Frobenius elements yield 4,4,1 root-block cases and exactly five witness-positive cases. Chebotarev supplies natural density 5/72. The standard-library checker verifies all requisite finite algebraic identities and several direct six-cycles; it does not replace Chebotarev.
